description: This file defines data models and utility functions related to GPU and system utilization statistics, including classes for utilization metrics, metadata, time series data, and schema information, primarily used within the PyTorch infrastructure.

classes.name: UtilizationStats
classes.description: Data model for storing average, maximum, and raw utilization data.

classes.name: UtilizationMetadata
classes.description: Metadata for utilization data, including workflow and job identifiers, resource counts, and error info.

classes.name: GpuUsage
classes.description: GPU-specific utilization metrics, including UUID and various utilization statistics.

classes.name: RecordData
classes.description: Aggregates CPU, memory, and GPU usage data for a record.

classes.name: UtilizationRecord
classes.description: Represents a utilization data record with timestamp, level, and optional logs.

classes.name: OssCiSegmentV1
classes.description: Schema for a segment of CI utilization data, including timing and extra info.

classes.name: OssCiUtilizationMetadataV1
classes.description: Schema for overall CI utilization metadata, including segments and tags.

classes.name: OssCiUtilizationTimeSeriesV1
classes.description: Schema for time series utilization data, including JSON data payload.

classes.name: WorkflowInfo
classes.description: Contains information about a workflow run, including IDs, names, and repository.

methods.name: getDataModelVersion
methods.description: Returns the current data model version as a float.

methods.name: getTsNow
methods.description: Returns the current timestamp as an integer.
